title: Independently audit the coupled provider and conditional closure budget (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent audit of Dillon's #5402 provider at exact head `3348fccea855082786d5f0fc5558b73d4974e745`, its literal ordinary work and a conditional closure-budget screen. A companion bounded review covers Ali Romman's #5376 all-width Clifford criterion and certificate boundary at `848cdce9003262c4b6e02ec4558f302e4fae56ad`. **No complete caller or new κ is admitted.**

The independent provider interpreter passes all **632 arbitrary original inputs plus nine arbitrary owned entries**, derives the unrestricted source identities and 122-owner basis rather than importing the candidate evaluator, verifies all **1,240 physical phase equations**, and returns all nine owned fields to zero. Ten controls reject actual instruction, basis, frame, absolute-phase, operator-order, false-credit and cache-content defects. The additional cache SCALE−1 control stays in the same physical chart and fails specifically because a later zero-retag input becomes nonzero.

The accepted endpoint is `X=Dx−Ry+RWh`, `Y=Dy`, `H=D(h−Zy)`, with `ZW=14I8` and `WZ=I−C`, preserving noncommuting order and exterior scalar coefficients at every positive width. The **eight H outputs remain coupled and earn zero autonomous Gaussian credit**. Four hundred other helpers retain their actual autonomous contract.

The paid profile already equals the validated #5398/#5400 comparison. The deletion of eight H8 and eight H1 calls is relative to the original raw source and is not another paid saving over that comparison. For a SPECIFIED hypothetical closure into the same eighteen-call p16 comparator, grant eight extra autonomous H8 targets per provider solely as a favorable assumption. At κ=.00302728823, all144 hypothetical targets have moment credit about1144.77085846746. Strict incremental aggregate homogeneous cleanup budgets are1144H1,143H8 or128H9, with all other jobs unchanged. **144 paid H8 exactly cancels144 target H8 rankwise.** This is a necessary conditional screen, not a construction, funded endpoint or universal coupled-controller ceiling. Every extra paid/lost-target/main/idle term and unknown ordinary cost remains explicit.

Literal counts are17,917ADD,1,204SCALE,16COPY,40CLEAR,eightSWAP and464monomial maps per provider. The corrected exact scalar tariff is175,022 units; the earlier independent checker inverted an already-final boundary coefficient twice and gave a conservative175,038. Its original artifacts are retained as version-scoped diagnostics. Counts, recursive profiles and moment budgets are unchanged; v3 uses the emitted factor directly. Monomial realization and consumer costs remain separate.

A fresh all-width local error proof derives exponent18,996 in the maximum-over-fields Euclidean norm, independently matching the author's stated geometry, and19,012 in the joint-field Euclidean norm. For either geometry every contiguous subinterval/suffix has norm at most2^L, giving `||e_out|| <= 2^L (||e_in|| + sum ||local_residual_j||)` at one fixed width. No coordinate-to-field conversion, recursive precision, tape/storage or compiler funding is hidden in that local statement.

The companion #5376 written-proof review covers trace separation, eight-copy invariant descent, zero/one-axis exceptions, sharp one-axis cutoff and the stated stability domain. Its independent oracle checks24programs/64directtensorwidths,17literalwitnesses,68forgedwitness rejections and a separately constructed96-matrix group/rank certificate. Submitted modules are comparison targets only. The negative witness checker does not independently accept a positive compact receipt, and shared word expansion remains a documented trust boundary. This package does **not** admit the complete #5376 provider,7,000 classes or30,328 fusion census.
